job_post_list.title: Software Engineer Intern (TikTok-Social-Friending) - 2027 Summer
job_post_list.description:
The team builds the products and infrastructure that help users discover people they know, establish and manage connections, and maintain meaningful relationships on TikTok.

Our work spans the full relationship lifecycle, from relationship discovery and connection establishment to relationship management and social graph services. We build reliable, scalable, and privacy-conscious experiences across TikTok’s backend, iOS, and Android platforms, providing the relationship foundation for a wide range of social experiences on TikTok.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities: 
As a Full-Stack Software Engineer Intern on the team, you will:
- Design, develop, and deliver business-critical systems and product features that power relationship discovery, connection, and management experiences on TikTok.
- Work across the full product stack, including backend services, iOS applications, and Android applications.
- Own features end to end—from technical design and API development to client implementation, testing, launch, and iteration.
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers across multiple teams to deliver high-quality products in a fast-paced environment.
- Write robust and maintainable code, create clear technical documentation, and deliver high-quality work on schedule.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications
- Currently pursuing an undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
- Able to commit to a 12-week internship during Summer 2027.
- Experience developing software across backend, iOS, or Android platforms, with the ability and willingness to contribute across all three.
- Strong understanding of computer architecture, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and software engineering principles.
- Experience designing APIs and integrating mobile applications with backend services.

Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience independently delivering an end-to-end feature spanning backend services and mobile clients.
- Familiarity with distributed systems, high-concurrency services, mobile architecture, networking, databases, or performance optimization.
- High levels of creativity and strong problem-solving capabilities.
- Strong learning ability, clear communication, and a strong sense of teamwork and responsibility.

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy

job_post_list.title: Backend Software Engineer Project Intern (Trust & Safety) - 2026 Start
job_post_list.description:
About the Team
Our Trust and Safety (TnS) Engineering team is responsible for protecting our users from harmful content and abusive behaviors. With the continuous efforts of our trust and safety team, TikTok can provide the best user experience and bring joy to everyone in the world.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities
- Collaborate with Trust and Safety experts, machine learning engineers, and other cross-functional teams on delivering key results;
- Design technical solutions with team members;
- Implement technical solutions to support business requirements.

job_post_list.title: Software Engineer Intern (TikTok- Developer Platform) - 2027 Summer
job_post_list.description:
About the Team
The Developer Platform team helps external developers and partners build secure, scalable, and high-quality integrations across our ecosystem. We provide APIs, SDKs, developer tools, internal platforms, and integration workflows that support authentication, data exchange, content sharing, and partner onboarding.

As a Full-Stack Engineer Intern, you will work with experienced engineers on real platform products used by developers and partners. You will have opportunities to contribute across frontend experiences, backend services, internal tools, and developer-facing workflows.

You may also explore how AI can improve developer experience and engineering productivity, such as smarter documentation, API debugging assistance, code examples, and workflow automation.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities
- Contribute to frontend features, backend services, APIs, and internal tools for the Developer Platform.
- Build clean and maintainable user interfaces for developer consoles, dashboards, integration tools, or internal operations systems.
- Help develop backend APIs, data flows, and platform capabilities that support secure and reliable integrations.
- Debug and improve issues across the stack, including frontend behavior, API contracts, service logs, and data consistency.
- Support developer experience improvements, such as onboarding flows, API testing tools, documentation workflows, and integration diagnostics.
- Explore practical AI-assisted features or tools that improve platform usability or engineering efficiency.
- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, team standups, and product development under the guidance of experienced engineers.
job_post_list.requirement:
Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Able to commit to a 12-week internship during Summer 2027.
- Solid understanding of programming fundamentals and basic web development concepts, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and HTTP.
- Familiarity with at least one programming language, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, or similar.
- Basic understanding of frontend, backend, databases, or APIs through coursework, projects, or internship experience.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn from feedback. Interest in developer platforms, full-stack engineering, or AI-assisted development tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, Angular, or similar.
- Experience building backend services, APIs, scripts, or data-driven applications.
- Familiarity with browser debugging tools, API testing tools, Git, or common development workflows.
- Exposure to developer platform concepts such as authentication, authorization, SDKs, webhooks, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or third-party integrations.
- Experience with side projects, personal websites, developer tools, open-source contributions, or AI-assisted applications.
- Interest in AI development concepts such as LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, agents, or AI coding tools.

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy
